value:
The Tarn Union has established a new trading post along the river road. One can only assume they are eager to grease the wheels of commerce, or perhaps merely to watch the slow rot of the interior.

Meanwhile, the weather prognosticators have issued a stark warning: a cold snap is forecast for the northern hills. Anyone foolish enough to be venturing north should pack more than just their desperation.

In other news, the Rim continues to churn. We note the continued presence of the Tarn Union, the Red Gully Raiders, and the Seven Ash Clans, though their particular machinations remain, as usual, obscured from this meager dispatch.
